runs.note: Current read settings (light-region fallback, status words never alarms). The phone started watching before the run, so its readings were matched to the ground truth by server time (score_soak --by-time) and its Gemini reads were not counted for this run.

Trial with the first read settings (counters re-read every minute with all three crops), at ten times the normal event rate, so reads and cost are far above a real line. The 3 false alarms were the screen word IDLE read as an alarm; status words are now never alarms.

cost_estimate.label: ESTIMATE
assumptions: Measured cost per read with gemini-3.5-flash-lite: $0.0011 for a full read (light, counter and screen crops), $0.00044 for a counter-only read.
Per machine per hour: 6 full check-ins, 30 counter-only reads (every 2 minutes) and about 3 stops, each needing 2 full reads.
One shift = 8 hours on 22 days a month. Fewer stops means fewer reads; a machine without a counter skips the counter reads.
